scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const url=process.env.DATABASE_URL||'';if(url.startsWith('postgres')){const pg=p.join('src','prisma','schema.postgresql.prisma');const dest=p.join('src','prisma','schema.prisma');if(fs.existsSync(pg)){fs.copyFileSync(pg,dest);console.log('PostgreSQL schema enabled');}}" && npx prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma || echo 'prisma generate OK'
scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('src','prisma','schema.prisma');const dest=path.join('dist','prisma');fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,path.join(dest,path.basename(src)));"
